title: Getting Started
content:
### Welcome to Aethermoor Chronicles

A dark fantasy RPG set in a world where **ancient magic** and **brutal warfare** collide. This guide will walk you through everything you need to know to start your journey.

#### Your First Steps:
* **Select your realm:** Choose the world where your legend begins.
* **Choose a class:** Pick a playstyle that suits you.
* **Understand core systems:** Learn how combat and progression drive the game.

> **Note:** Aethermoor features a living world that reacts to your decisions—every choice carries weight.

#### The World Map
The continent is split into **five major regions**, each with its own factions, climate, and threats. You will begin in the *Ashveil Borderlands*, a war-torn frontier where the story unfolds naturally.

title: Character Creation
content:
### Creating Your Legend

Character creation is one of the most in-depth systems in Aethermoor. Take your time—this defines your entire experience.

#### 1. Choose Your Race
Each of the **six races** offers unique passive traits and stat bonuses:
* **Human & Elven:** Balanced and magical affinity.
* **Dwarven & Orc:** Toughness and raw power.
* **Faeborn & Undying:** Unique utility and specialized survival.

#### 2. Distribute Attributes
You have **30 free points** to distribute across:
* `Strength` | `Dexterity` | `Intelligence` | `Vitality` | `Willpower` 

#### 3. Background Story
Finally, pick a background. This grants a **unique starting item** and a hidden bonus discovered only through gameplay.

title: Controls & UI Overview
content:
### Master the Interface

Aethermoor uses a standard **WASD** movement scheme with mouse-aimed abilities.

#### Keybinds Quick Reference:
| Key | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| **WASD** | Movement |
| **1-0 / F1-F2** | Ability Slots (12 total) |
| **M** | World Map |
| **I** | Inventory |
| **C** | Character Screen |
| **K** | Skill Tree |
| **Alt+Z** | Toggle HUD (Screenshots) |

#### The HUD Explained
* **Left Globe:** Health (Your life essence).
* **Right Globe:** Mana (Required for spells).
* **Bottom Bar:** Experience (XP) progress.
* **Top Right:** Minimap and active tracking.

title: Progression & Leveling
content:
### Leveling Up

The level cap in Aethermoor is **60**. You earn XP from killing enemies, completing quests, discovering locations, and crafting.

#### Level Rewards:
* **Attribute Points:** 3 per level.
* **Skill Points:** 1 per level.
* **Class Milestones:** Unlocked at levels `10, 20, 30, 40, 50`—these fundamentally change your build.

#### Endgame Progression:
Upon reaching level 60, you unlock **Prestige mechanics**. This allows you to reset your character in exchange for **permanent bonuses** that carry over to your next run.

title: Death & Respawn Mechanics
content:
### Facing Defeat

When your health reaches zero, you enter a **Downed State** for 10 seconds. If an ally revives you, you can continue the fight.

#### The Consequences of Death:
* **Soulstone Respawn:** If not revived, you return to the nearest magical checkpoint.
* **Soul Shards:** You drop a shard containing **10% of your gold and some XP**. You must recover it before it disappears!
* **Revive Scrolls:** Rare items that allow you to respawn exactly where you died without penalty.

> **Hardcore Mode:** Be warned—in this mode, death is permanent and your character is deleted.

title: Warrior
content:
### The Warrior

The backbone of any group. Warriors excel at absorbing damage and controlling the battlefield.

* **Resource:** `Rage` (Generated by taking/dealing damage).
* **Stat Priority:** `Strength` > `Vitality`.

#### Signature Abilities:
1. **Shield Slam:** Damage + Stun.
2. **Battlecry:** Buffs nearby allies.
3. **Whirlwind:** Powerful AoE spinning attack.

#### Subclasses (Level 20):
* **Guardian:** The ultimate tank.
* **Berserker:** High-damage melee specialist.
* **Warlord:** Support and tactical command.

title: Mage
content:
### The Mage

Mages wield raw elemental forces to devastate enemies from a distance. High damage, but very fragile.

* **Resource:** `Mana` (Regenerates slowly or via potions).
* **Stat Priority:** `Intelligence` > `Willpower`.

#### Signature Abilities:
1. **Fireball:** Massive single-target burn.
2. **Frost Nova:** Freezes enemies in place.
3. **Arcane Surge:** A powerful channeled magic beam.

#### Specializations:
* **Pyromancer:** Fire and destruction.
* **Cryomancer:** Ice and crowd control.
* **Arcanist:** Pure magic utility and raw power.

title: Rogue
content:
### The Rogue

Masters of deception and burst damage. They operate from the shadows and strike before the enemy can react.

* **Resource:** `Energy` (Regenerates quickly).
* **Stat Priority:** `Dexterity` > `Strength`.

#### Signature Abilities:
* **Shadowstep:** Teleport behind a target.
* **Eviscerate:** Massive finishing move damage.
* **Smoke Screen:** Escape and re-enter stealth.

#### Subclasses:
* **Assassin:** Pure single-target burst.
* **Shadowdancer:** High mobility and AoE blades.
* **Trickster:** Focuses on debuffs and CC.

title: Cleric
content:
### The Cleric

Primary healers who channel divine light to mend wounds and protect the party.

* **Resource:** `Faith` (Built through holy actions).
* **Stat Priority:** `Willpower` > `Vitality`.

#### Core Spells:
* **Healing Wave:** Multi-target heal.
* **Holy Shield:** Absorbs incoming damage.
* **Consecrate:** Holy ground that heals allies and burns foes.

#### Paths of Light:
* **Paladin:** Melee healer wearing heavy plate armor.
* **High Priest:** Maximum healing output.
* **Inquisitor:** Offensive cleric focused on enemy debuffs.

title: Ranger
content:
### The Ranger

Versatile hunters with a deep connection to nature and tracking.

* **Resource:** `Focus` (Builds by landing attacks).
* **Stat Priority:** `Dexterity` > `Intelligence`.

#### Signature Abilities:
* **Rain of Arrows:** Large area volley.
* **Eagle Eye:** Precision shot for massive damage.
* **Tame Beast:** Capture creatures to fight by your side.

#### Hunter Archetypes:
* **Bowmaster:** Pure ranged mastery.
* **Beastmaster:** Focuses on companion strength.
* **Trapper:** Zone denial and crowd control.

title: Combat Fundamentals
content:
### Combat Mechanics

Combat in Aethermoor is action-oriented. Success depends on timing and positioning.

#### Defensive Manuevers:
* **Blocking:** Reduces damage by **40%** (consumes stamina).
* **Dodge Rolling:** Grants a **0.5s invincibility window**.
* **Telegraphs:** Watch for red circles on the ground to avoid AoE attacks.

#### Elemental Interactions:
Status effects can combo for massive damage:
> **Example:** A *Frozen* enemy hit by *Fire* takes double damage and is **Shattered**.

title: Crafting & Professions
content:
### Professions & Crafting

There are **six main professions** in Aethermoor. You can learn them all, but mastering them takes time.

#### Available Jobs:
1. **Blacksmithing:** Armor and weapons.
2. **Alchemy:** Potions and flasks.
3. **Enchanting:** Gear power-ups.
4. **Leatherworking / Jewelcrafting / Runeforging**

#### Quality Matters:
Output quality depends on your profession level and **Special Reagents**. Master crafters can add extra slots to gear or create **Unique Legendaries**.

title: PvP Modes & Arenas
content:
### Player vs Player (PvP)

Test your skills against other players in three distinct modes:

* **Open World:** Conflict zones where players glow red. Watch out for *Bounty Hunters* if your Infamy gets too high!
* **Arenas (2v2 / 5v5):** Ranked seasonal combat in sealed maps.
* **Siege Warfare:** Guild vs Guild battles for fortresses. Control a fort to earn **resource bonuses** for your guild.

> PvP stats scale separately from PvE to ensure a fair competitive environment.

title: Dungeons & Raids
content:
### Endgame Challenges

#### Dungeons (5 Players)
Instances with 3-5 bosses. Available in **Normal, Heroic, and Mythic** difficulties.

#### Raids (20 Players)
The pinnacle of PvE content. Features 8-12 bosses with unique, complex mechanics.

* **Lockouts:** Weekly resets occur every **Monday at 6 AM**.
* **Loot:** Personal loot system ensures everyone has a fair chance at gear.

title: Economy & Trading
content:
### The Player-Driven Economy

#### Currency Tiers:
* **Copper → Silver → Gold**
* **Aether Crystals:** Premium currency earned through high-end content.

#### Trading Tools:
* **Auction House:** List items in major cities for gold.
* **Secure Trade:** A safe window for direct player-to-player exchanges.

> **Market Tip:** Prices fluctuate based on supply and demand. Keep an eye on seasonal events for rare items!
